action_axel: Two things you should know, and only the second needs a decision. First: yesterday, 30 September, was the first profitable day since the 23rd. All three campaigns together spent 7 764 kr for 12 purchases at ROAS 1.96, CPA 647 against break-even 693. The listicle track carried it, LISTICLE at 2.59 and the new copy at 1.82 against the main campaign's 1.41 — which is the opposite of what the 29th said, when LISTICLE fell hardest of the three. Two days, two opposite answers: neither is enough to conclude anything, and I will not read this again until all three have run a full week on their new budgets, so 6 October at the earliest. Second: the round cut your 3 000 kr to 2 100 tonight. I flagged on the 29th that it counts cadence from its own log and would do exactly this if the 3-day profit was still under 16 %; no answer came, the 3-day profit was -19.0 %, so it did. That is the rules working, but the cut landed the day after the best day of the week, because the 3-day window still carries the 29th. If you want the main campaign back at 3 000, say so and I will set it
